description.value:
This set of small bands encircle your wrists, elbows, chest, hips, knees and ankles, each embedded with a small glowing crystal. When worn together, ghostly machinery connects these bands, forming an exoskeleton that supplements your strength and endurance and gives you one foot in the Ethereal Plane. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks, and you can carry an additional 3 Bulk without becoming encumbered.

Activate—Slip Between 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You slip partially into the Ethereal Plane until the end of your next turn. Creatures on the Universe can't see you, and you can move through objects and walls in the Universe. You can still see onto the Universe, though anything there is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] from you. You can't affect the Universe and can't be affected by the Universe, except by ghost killer upgrades and similar effects, which treat you as an incorporeal creature. You move at half your normal Speeds but can move in any direction (including up and down).

When the effect ends, you return fully to the Universe. If you're in the air, you fall (unless you can fly), and if you're inside an object, you're pushed to the nearest open space and take @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage per 5 feet you were pushed. You can extend the effect by 1 round when you Sustain it, to a maximum duration of 1 minute.
